title: The Epistemic Suite: A Post-Foundational Diagnostic Methodology for Assessing AI Knowledge Claims

bias_targets.methodology: Applying the Intercultural Legitimacy Engine (ILE) and Ground Truth Dissolver (GTD) lenses to detect the imposition of dominant Western frameworks on Indigenous knowledge, unidirectional translation, and the universalization of culturally situated claims.

Using the Power Signature Mapper (PSM) and Meta-Legitimacy Engine (MLE) to analyze citation patterns, funding sources, and institutional affiliations to identify concentrations of epistemic authority, gatekeeping, and structural exclusions.
Employing the Liberal Tolerance Engine (LTE) to surface missing counter-perspectives, suppressed dissent, artificial consensus, and instances where dominant ideological frames are treated as neutral.

Using the Scientism Detection Engine (SDE) and other foundational lenses to flag when empirical, scientific, or technical authority is illegitimately extended to dismiss experiential, embodied, or alternative cultural knowledge systems.
